11 January, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:5444
Court No. - 90
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 93 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt Renu Mathur And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants for quashing and setting aside the impugned order dated 15.12.2023, whereby the learned trial court rejected an application for condonation from personal appearance and issued non-bailable warrant against the applicants-accused and further quashing and setting aside the impugned First Information Report dated 8.12.2019 arising out of Case Crime No. 284 of 2019 under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 354, 377,
504 and 506 I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act at Police Station Mahila Thana Ghaziabad, District Ghaziabad and stay the proceedings and further stay the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 9898 of 2020 (State Vs. Dr. Shobhit Mathur and another) under Sections 498A,
323, 504 and 506 I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act arising out of Case Crime No.
284 of 2020 under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 504 and 506 I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act at Police Station Mahila Thana Ghaziabad, District Ghaziabad.

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that previously Hon'ble Supreme Court by order dated 12.08.2022 granted liberty for exemption from personal appearance of the applicants.
The applicants have moved an application for exemption on personal appearance although the applicants were appearing before the court below on previous dates.
Learned counsel for the applicants undertakes to appear before the court concerned on the next date and the exemption was sought on the ground of illness as well as distance.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants in the present case will appear before the trial court and shall not disturb the trial court proceedings by the absence of the applicants.

Learned counsel for the applicants further submits that the applicants will also apply to appear before the court concerned through Video Conferencing facility in pursuance to the Rules for Video Conferencing for Courts in the State of Uttar Pradesh, 2020.
4. Learned A.G.A. for the State would have no objection in the event applicants appear before the court concerned through Video Conferencing.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and the fact that the present is a matrimonial dispute and applicants have given an undertaking to appear before the court concerned in person or through Video Conferencing as per the Rules for Video Conferencing for Courts in the State of Uttar Pradesh, 2020, the non-bailable warrant order issued by order dated 15.12.2023 shall be kept in abeyance.

In order to enable the applicants to appear before the court concerned, liberty is also granted to the applicants to apply before the court concerned to appear through Video Conferencing in accordance with law.
In case any such application is filed before the trial court, the trial court is directed to consider the same within ten days and pass an appropriate order.

In the event applicants does not appear before the court concerned either personally or through Video Conferencing as may be permitted in accordance with the Rules for Video Conferencing for Courts in the State of Uttar Pradesh, 2020,
the court below would be at liberty to enforce the non-bailable warrant issued by order dated 15.12.2023.
6.
With the aforesaid observation/direction, application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.

Order Date :- 11.1.2024 VMA  Smt Renu Mathur And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119709355/
